name: Agathion, Pride Lord (3pp)
body:
Pride Lord Agathion
CR 9

XP 6,400
LN Huge outsider (agathion)
Init +3 Senses darkvision 90 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +8 natural armor, -2 size)
hp 138 (12d10+72)
Regen 5 (silver and fire)
Fort +13, Ref +7, Will +13
Immune electricity, petrification, blindness, deafness; Resist cold 10, sonic 10

OFFENSE

Speed 75 ft.
Melee +17/+12/+7 thundering two-bladed sword (1d10+7 slashing, 19-20/x2)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 12th concentration +18)

At Will–flame strike (Ref DC 20), lion’s roar (Fort DC 20)
3x/day–summon nature’s ally V
1x/day–breath of life, summon nature’s ally VI

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 17, Con 21, Int 13, Wis 20, Cha 16
Base Atk +12; CMB +19; CMD 32
Feats Cleave, Great Cleave, Intimidating Prowess, Power Attack, Run, Toughness
Skills Acrobatics +20, Climb +20, Intimidate +23, Knowledge (nature, planes) +17, Stealth +10, Survival +20
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, speak with animals, truespeech
SQ lay on hands (9x/day, 6d6 hp, as a 12th-level paladin: blinded, fatigued, frightened, shaken mercies)
Gear +2 thundering two-bladed sword

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Intimidating Roar (Ex)

As a standard action, the Pride Lord can scream a terrifying roar. This allows the Pride Lord to make an Intimidate check against all creatures subject to mind-affecting effects within 90 ft. and can clearly see and hear him.

ECOLOGY

Environment extraplanar (native to Nirvana, but found on multiple planes in pursuit of their mission)
Organization usually solitary
Treasure standard

Pride Lords are a predatory breed of agathion guardians spawned by the living and sapient realm of Nirvana. Unlike most of their kind, they are not good souls – they are killers when necessary, and view the universe as an intertwined web of predators and prey.

Pride Lords are unbearably haughty and imperious warriors without compare. They treat the entire multiverse as their domain.

Pride Lords stand well over a 12 ft. tall. They are proud bipeds whose features exemplify the fearsome majesty of nature. Their faces are leonine, accented by the horns of a ram and the tusks of a boar; their legs are equine and powerful. A Pride Lord’s pelt is a rich sable, and where their flesh is left uncovered, it gleams like living gold.
